lenses.brief: G1, MECHANICS AND CONTRACT with the art Punk. Judge the merged head against the slice gate's pass items 1-3 (Part C §6 as amended by A15) and Part B's measured rows that touch the art, each with evidence. (1) REPRODUCIBLE: tools/pipeline/run.py --asset punk --from smoke (headless Blender only) rebuilds the same report hash, and the ledger (assets/source/tripo_ledger.jsonl, 55 credits) accounts for every credit. It must spend no Tripo credit: read run.py first, and if any step would call Tripo, don't run it; judge from the code. (2) CONTRACT: test_art_contract, test_skinned_art and test_art_punk green; no neutral_bone; SkinnedArt.check() strict for all four GLBs; the A3 chained bind route and the chained-joint rule (P1-chain measured a 2.35 cm landmark residual against A3's 1 cm: rule whether it matters). (3) MECHANICS WITH THE ART, in first person in both rooms: it fights; the flash lands on the struck spot for 2 frames (A11: the anchor sits 4-5 cm off the skin at the torso and legs: visible or not?); damage marks stick through motion (A10); the skin follows the ragdoll (the write-back: no gap, pop or stretch at knockdown, KO and get-up); the KO view and the blink-off; FP layers (the art never clips the camera at 1 m, in grabs or holds; FPView.is_drawn()/depths() honest). (4) PROXY HONESTY (A4, A9): the art is bulkier than the proxies in strikes (6.1% of cells differ at the jab against the 3% bar; art up to 57-61 cm nearer the lens in a cell). Does any proxy-based number (readability_probe R4/R8, engage_meter, the FP coverage tests, A6 hurtbox fit) now pass for the wrong reason? Run A4's windowed evidence act with the art drawn (L5: R4 and R8, which SL-int did not run) and compare it with the proxies' figures. Also check the art warm-up (the first-spawn hitch), leaked-resource ERROR lines at exit in recordings, and the autopilot crowd logs (tools/check_m3_log.py). LOCK in `locks`: the bind route on the mechanics side (A-pose route or the arms-down bake), the proxy decision (widen the proxies, slim the art, or accept the proxy figures), and the edge-mask outcome (A8: the dilated character mask or a fallback). Give `gaps` for the mechanics gaps phase 2 must close (owners: F-punk, F-player-art, F-player-int, F-motion, F-look, P3-int) and your `verdict` from the mechanics side.

G2, DEFORMATION AND LOOK AT 1 m IN FIRST PERSON. Judge from SL-int's full-resolution C1-C5 and C13 stills and crops, the A19 strain report's worst ten (M4-calls/SL-int.md §3; the ART-PUNK lines of test_art_punk), the weights and bind-route A/B (captures/sl-int/ab, abmontage, and P1-chain's report/stills/ab_weights_x_route.png), and the before/after pack (captures/m4_before/<slug>/ against SL-int's) against docs/milestones/M4-look-bible.md and Part B's rubric J1-J14 (critical items first). Record more where you need it, one act per process into your worktree's captures/review/: C2, C4 and C5 per variant with CAPTURE_ARGS="--tune=look_punk_art_variant=N", FXAA against 4x MSAA with --tune=look_aa_mode=1, the placeholder hulls off with --tune=look_hull_on_placeholders=0. Check: (1) DEFORMATION at 1 m: the shoulder, armpit and vest collar in the arm raise, jab, cross and spine twist; the foot seam face down; whether any of it shows in first person at 1 m, both still and in motion (12 fps sheets). (2) THE LOOK CHAIN on the real asset (slice gate item 4): 2-3 bands, tinted shadows that are never black, the hull near look_outline_px (measure it at 1 m and 2.5 m against the bible's 3.5-4 px at 1080p; captures are 1600x900, so x0.83), edges with no double silhouette, the grade on. (3) PALETTE BORDERS at 1 m (risk R5: jaggy or clean?). (4) FIDELITY against the concept (concept A: ASSETS.md's Concepts rows name the image): the gloves reading as canisters (J3), the saw-tooth vest hem and collar, the forearm colour mismatch, the mouthless face, bloodied skin going translucent grey, and J13 (the placeholders beside the art). LOCK in `locks`: the weights source (tripo or auto), the bind route on the deformation side (A-pose route or the arms-down bake), the fit, the border method (border-protected decimation or the posterized-texture fallback), outline px, the AA mode by look (4x MSAA or FXAA; the lead adds the perf), and whether the placeholder hulls stay on by look. Rank `gaps` worst first, each as one phase-2 brief line with its owner (F-punk, F-player-art, F-player-int, F-motion, F-look, P3-int), and give your `verdict` (A15's a; b with the named contingency: weight smoothing or edge loops at named joints, the arms-down bake, Tripo weights, or A18's Punk detail mask; or c).

packages.title: The chain-to-shader contract: hull normals in glTF axes, a skin class for damage marks, run.py step validation
packages.notes:
Severity first: slice-g2-01 (high) is the must-land item. Do it first and commit it before you start slice-g2-07. Shared root: what the chain bakes into the GLB and atlas does not match what the toon shaders read.

1) slice-g2-01, hull normals.
- In blender_export.write_hull_normals (lines 64-87), convert each smooth normal to glTF Y-up before the encode: n_gltf = (n.x, n.z, -n.y), then rgba[:, :3] = n_gltf * 0.5 + 0.5. Fix the docstring at line 12 ('in glTF Y-up axes').
- Do not touch toon_outline.gdshader. The Godot-side fixture, test_toon and the documented contract already assume Y-up COLOR.
- Re-export through the chain from its cached steps, never re-running Tripo:
  - tripo weights: `python3 -I tools/pipeline/run.py --asset punk --from export`;
  - auto weights: the same with `--set rig.weights="auto"` plus paths.report=report_auto and paths.export_name=punk_auto. Confirm the exact override set from report_auto's recorded config and M4-calls/P1-chain.md.
  - Both bind routes come out of each run. Rebuild the probe fixtures with `python3 -I tools/pipeline/make_probe_body.py`.
- PROVE THE RE-EXPORT CHANGED ONLY COLOR_0. Byte-compare every other accessor and the skin and node data, old against new GLB: POSITION, NORMAL, TEXCOORD_*, JOINTS_0, WEIGHTS_0, indices, inverse binds. Put the result in your calls file. That proof keeps every other gate number valid: A6, A9, A19, strain and perf.
- Then run `godot --headless --import --quit`. In test_art_contract.gd's test_hull_normals_and_the_detail_uv_are_there, add two per-mesh assertions on each shipped GLB and the probe fixtures:
  - the mean dot(normalize(COLOR.rgb*2-1), NORMAL) is at least about 0.85 (the correct decode measures 0.92-0.96);
  - it beats the (x, z, -y)-permuted read, so the axis frame cannot regress.
- `run.py --asset punk --check` and the auto-variant check must both pass afterwards. Record both commands and results in your calls file; the lead cites them as gate pass (1).
- Windowed (one Godot process at a time):
  - re-measure L1 at 1, 2.5, 5 and 10 m;
  - record C1, C2, C4 and C6 into your worktree's captures/ (never commit them);
  - look at the full-resolution stills and 2x crops: ink continuous on the cap crown and the elbow and forearm bottoms, an even width, and no new doubling with the edge pass. Report the numbers and what you saw.
- Optional, last (from slice-g2-05, which the other package owns): add the authored mesh's folded-triangle count (face winding against its vertex normals) to the export step's report. Do not change decimation or geometry: fold removal is an F-punk brief line.

2) slice-g2-07, damage on skin.
- Add a skin class: a `skin: true` flag on shared.json slots 6-9, written by gen_palette.py as a third atlas alpha value, for example 1.0 clothes marks, 0.75 skin marks, 0.5 none. Keep it byte-reproducible. Update pipe_common.py only if it validates the alpha.
- Regenerate palette_atlas.png and update the alpha assertion at test_art_contract.gd:501.
- In toon.gdshader, add `damage_skin_tex` with a clear default hint. The skin alpha selects it over damage_tex in the triplanar.
- In DamageLook.apply_art(), set damage_tex to the clothes tiles as today and damage_skin_tex to texture_for(Paint.SKIN), the bruised then bloodied tiles that M3's primitives wore. prepare() fills both with the clear texture.
- Do NOT edit game/fx/toon_materials.gd or tests/test_art_punk.gd; the other package owns them.
  - If a material default is needed, set it in DamageLook.prepare(), or in RigPaint only if the slot fill lives there.
  - test_art_punk's A10 reads damage_tex only, so keep damage_tex's clothes sequence unchanged. Put the skin-tile assertion in test_damage_look.gd.
  - Update the uniform list in test_toon.gd, and test_m4_contracts.gd if it pins it.
- Leave the lens and cap swatch in punk.json alone. Re-assigning palette slots changes the GLB's UVs and would break the COLOR-only proof. It is an F-punk brief line, as is the scuffed tile's own art (tools/gen_fx.gd, not yours).
- Any mark-strength number goes in the palette JSON as data, never a script constant. If a tunable is truly needed, it goes only in tuning_data.gd's Look > Toon subgroup; the lead regenerates tuning/default.json.
- Evidence: record the damage-looks act (100/65/30%, then hits, C5) and check at 1 m that skin shows bruises then blood, clothes show scuffs, and the face no longer goes grey.

3) slice-g1-05, run.py step validation.
- In run.py, validate opts['from'] and opts['only'] against STEP_NAMES before any side effect (before gen_palette and the effective-config write; today the indexing is at lines 202 and 207). On a bad name, print a usage line listing the steps and return 2. Confirm `--from smoke` now exits 2 and writes nothing.
- Replace `--from smoke` with `--check` at M4-plan.md:716, and at m4-plan-vertical-slice.md:256 (optional).

Docs you own:
- ARCHITECTURE.md: :863, COLOR hull_normal in the GLB's Y-up axes like NORMAL; :870 and :922, the palette alpha classes and the new uniform; :929, damage on art.
- M4-plan.md: :594, and Part C §2.6 and §2.7.
- Do not edit M4-calls/SL-int.md or P1-*.md: the lead's M4-slice-gate.md corrects SL-int's 'even 3 px ink hull' claim.
- Log your calls and numbers in docs/milestones/M4-calls/SG-chain.md.

Rules:
- Headless Blender only, never the Blender MCP, and never alongside a Godot process of your own.
- If gen_palette rewrites the atlas during a chain run before your palette change, it must stay byte-identical: check git diff.
- Run the full suite (tools/run_tests.sh) at the end and read the whole output for SCRIPT ERROR, SHADER ERROR and ERROR. The count only goes up.
Running at the same time (disjoint files): the other gate fixer, and F-motion (worktree .worktrees/m4-f-motion, branch m4/f-motion), which owns game/actors/placeholder_poses.gd, placeholder_anims.gd, game/actors/poses/*.gd, tests/test_motion_m4.gd and tests/bot/acts/look_motion_acts.gd. Don't touch those. F-motion also adds a heading at the end of ARCHITECTURE's M4 section and a Motion subgroup to tuning_data.gd; the lead merges both.

packages.title: The instruments and the warm-up follow the drawn body: R4 counts art Punks, SkinnedView reads the ragdoll pose, strain flips against the skinned rest, the art warm-up in the lens
packages.notes:
Shared root: M4's measurement code and the load-time warm-up still assume what M3 drew, or what the FK pose or the pre-update camera says, rather than what the lens draws. Every item here is a test or presentation fix. None changes game state or an asset.

1) slice-g1-03, the warm-up placement (medium).
- ToonMaterials.warm_up() reads the camera right after `await process_frame`, before the FirstPersonCamera's first _process, so the holder lands at (0,-1.2,-2.5), out of the frustum.
- Place it only after the camera's first update: a second process_frame, RenderingServer.frame_pre_draw, or the player's get_eye_transform() and look basis via RoomKit.warm_up_art. Verify which ordering actually holds in 4.7.2.
- Edit only warm_up() in toon_materials.gd and warm_up_art() in room_kit.gd. The other package must not touch toon_materials.gd and you must not touch any material defaults.
- Add a windowed check in look_acts.gd, in an existing or a new look act, plus test_look_acts.gd if acts are pinned. Log a LOOK line saying the holder's skinned ArtBody AABB and the hull boxes intersect the camera frustum on both frames they exist, in the crowd room and the training room. Record that act and quote the line.
- Do NOT run tools/perf_compare.sh: two other builders share the machine. The lead re-measures first spawn and first hit after the merge.

2) slice-g2-05, the flip half of the strain test (medium).
- In test_art_punk._strain and SkinnedView.strain, a triangle counts as flipped only when sign(dot(winding normal, mean vertex normal)) in the pose differs from the same sign at the skinned rest. Keep the squash test (area below 15% of the skinned rest). The P1-chain C13 reference stays.
- Print the authored mesh's folded-triangle count per GLB as its own ART-PUNK number (about 159 on punk.glb).
- Re-print A7 and A19 for all four GLBs: elbow 150, knee -130, spine twist, guard and arm raise. Expected: elbow about 41-45, knee about 60-63 and twist about 48-59 pass; guard 97-128 is near the 75 bar; the arm raise fails. Report what you measure.
- test_skinned_art's probe-fixture strain tests have a baseline of 0 and must stay green.
- Fold removal in the chain is NOT yours. It is an F-punk brief line; the other package may add a fold count to the chain report.

3) slice-g1-01, R4 on art Punks.
- In readability_probe._sample_occlusion, replace `not mesh.is_visible_in_tree()` with `not FPView.is_drawn(mesh)`, so the proxies count, matching R8 and A4.
- Add a test_readability_probe case: two StreetPunks in line with the art on, the rear one winding up; expect share 1.0.
- Re-run one autopilot crowd act ('Six Punks, fight', or the act SL-int used for auto_six). Confirm R4 still reads its true figure and R8 is unchanged.

4) slice-g1-06, SkinnedView's pose source (low).
- Add a pose source to hits(), _soup(), _skin_matrices and _pose_key, plus the compare_* wrappers: when rig.is_ragdolling(), use the ragdoll's visual pose per bone (rig.get_ragdoll().visual_pose(i), or whatever the real 4.7 API in ragdoll.gd is), else rig.animation_pose(). Update the header comment at lines 10-12.
- Add a test_skinned_art case: a staggered rig whose hits() agrees with skin_vertices(..., visual globals) and differs from FK.
- The L5 evidence act is P3-int's; just make the path available.

Rules:
- Do not edit docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, M4-plan.md or any other package's M4-calls file; the other package owns ARCHITECTURE.md. Write the exact replacement sentences in docs/milestones/M4-calls/SG-instruments.md for the lead to paste at merge: R4's filter at :569; A4 and the strain flip rule at :904-908; the warm-up wording at :933 and :992; the SkinnedView pose source.
- No tuning_data.gd changes.
- One Godot process at a time, never left running. Never commit captures/.
- Run the full suite at the end and read the whole output for SCRIPT ERROR, SHADER ERROR and ERROR.
Running at the same time (disjoint files): the other gate fixer, and F-motion (worktree .worktrees/m4-f-motion, branch m4/f-motion), which owns game/actors/placeholder_poses.gd, placeholder_anims.gd, game/actors/poses/*.gd, tests/test_motion_m4.gd and tests/bot/acts/look_motion_acts.gd. unassigned.reason: Out of scope for the gate's fixers: this is F-look's job. Plan Part C §7 gives F-look '2-3 readable bands on the jacket' and the toon, post, room_kit and Look tunables, and F-look starts on the gate's locks. Tuning band_2 and the sun now would pre-empt that tuning and collide with the instruments package's toon_materials.gd and room_kit.gd. It becomes a phase-2 brief line for F-look: band_2 below cos(sun elevation) = 0.616; a sun or character-light change so contre-jour fronts (about half of all enemies, whatever the azimuth) still show 2-3 bands; each swatch's rendered mid band within about 10° of its hue (teal not blue, skin not lilac); C2 recorded front-lit and back-lit.

Out of scope for the gate's fixers: the full mitt and the near_black glove are the smoke asset's, and F-punk replaces both hands through T9. Plan §7 F-punk step 4 already specifies a dark fingerless glove with bare fingers and an accent strap, with the knuckle face shown to the lens. Fixing the chain-inherited parts now means re-running parts_replace and palette. That changes the Punk's geometry and UVs mid-gate, invalidates the A/B numbers, and breaks the chain package's COLOR-only re-export proof. tools/pipeline/** and palette/punk.json are F-punk's in phase 2. They become F-punk brief lines: replace_hands sets the cuff radius from the wrist, not the cut's 90th percentile; a dark glove swatch stays at a value of about 0.3 or more, so its shadow band clears the ink.

Needs Game-boy, and it is F-punk's work. Adding the detail mask departs from SPEC §10's asset table (enemies use the shared atlas only), so spec_change is true. A18 says F-punk adds the 1k ink-only mask on UV2, baked from the dense texture (mouth, pocket flaps and buttons, stitching, tape edges, never shading), and logs it in README's M4 departures for his ruling. The gate's part is to record that A18's trigger is met (interior lines missing at 1 m), which feeds verdict (b), 'proven with a contingency'.
